paragraphs: Most people in high-stakes positions believe they have to choose. Drive results or stay playful. Build the career or keep the private life whole. Perform or stay alive to it. You have probably felt that pull — and suspected the trade was false.

For over eight years I have sat with founders and CEOs inside the decisions that have no clean answer. The founder whose work has quietly begun to demand everything. The CEO who manages tasks all day and has half-accepted that going through the motions is simply how it is now. The conversation I care about is the one where the strategy and the person behind it are the same conversation.
That is the work — the whole person, the whole business, the whole life, at the same time rather than in sequence.

What I bring comes from a long arc. Running my own businesses: hiring, firing, opening, closing. Years as a professional dancer and choreographer across Europe. Somatic practice, shiatsu, martial arts, several thousand hours in meditation. ICF PCC certification, with training in leadership coaching, ACT, and contemplative practice. When you are in the room with me, none of it stays at the door, and none of your situation gets reduced to a single dimension.

The hardest rooms are the ones I am built for — where it is genuinely unclear, where no tidy answer has arrived yet, where most advice flattens what is actually at stake. That is where the real work happens.

I live between the Alpstein and the Bodensee with my wife, Jae. We share time with family and long conversations about whatever is alive right now. I write often, and keep a deep interest in philosophy, science, business, and the human condition.
